title: RevisionApp content pack
description: The topic tree, the tags and the list of card files one pack owns.

packId.description: Must equal the id this pack is listed under in manifest.json.

structureVerified.description: False when the topic hierarchy was built from memory rather than from the published specification. The pack README must then list what needs checking.

cardFiles.description: Bare file names inside cards/. raw.githubusercontent.com cannot list a directory, so the pack has to declare them.

slug.description: Unique within the pack. Used to build builtin:<pack-id>:<slug> and to name the card file.

parent.description: Slug of the parent topic, or null/absent for a root. Nesting is unlimited.

slug.description: Unique across every group in the pack, because card files reference tags by slug alone.

group.description: Tags in the same group are OR-ed together; different groups are AND-ed.
